mapper.update: update t_int_session set ses_report_status = 1, ses_report_error = null, ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId} and ses_status = 2 and (ses_report_status in (0, 3) or (ses_report_status = 1 and ses_updated_at < date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{staleMinutes} minute)))
update t_int_session set ses_report_status = 2, ses_report_error = null, ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId} and ses_report_status = 1
update t_int_session set ses_report_status = 3, ses_report_error = #{error}, ses_report_retry = ses_report_retry + 1, ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId} and ses_report_status = 1
update t_int_session set ses_report_retry = 0 where ses_id = #{sessionId} and ses_report_status = 3
mapper.select: select s.ses_id as sessionId, s.ses_status as status, s.ses_mode as mode, s.ses_position_id as positionId, p.pos_company_id as companyId, p.pos_title as positionTitle, cast(p.pos_jd_json as char) as positionJd, ifnull(m.mst_current_question, 0) as answeredCount, ifnull(m.mst_total_question, 0) as totalQuestionNo, s.ses_report_status as reportStatus, s.ses_report_retry as reportRetry from t_int_session s left join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id left join t_int_meeting_state m on m.mst_session_id = s.ses_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId}
select dlg_role as role, dlg_type as type, dlg_content as content, dlg_order as orderNo from t_int_dialogue where dlg_session_id = #{sessionId} and dlg_type <> 3 order by dlg_order asc, dlg_id asc
select oln_id as questionId, oln_topic as topic, oln_description as description, oln_dimension as dimension from t_int_outline where oln_session_id = #{sessionId} order by oln_order asc, oln_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into t_int_evaluation (evl_session_id, evl_overall_score, evl_dimension_scores, evl_summary, evl_advantages, evl_risks, evl_gaps, evl_recommendation, evl_created_at) values (#{sessionId}, #{overallScore}, #{dimensionScores}, #{summary}, #{advantages}, #{risks}, #{gaps}, #{recommendation}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select s.ses_id as sessionId, e.evl_overall_score as overallScore, cast(e.evl_dimension_scores as char) as dimensionScores, e.evl_summary as summary, e.evl_recommendation as recommendation, date_format(e.evl_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as readyAt from t_int_session s join t_int_evaluation e on e.evl_session_id = s.ses_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId} limit 1

select s.ses_id from t_int_session s where s.ses_status = 2 and s.ses_end_at >= date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{scanDays} day) and (s.ses_report_status = 0 or (s.ses_report_status = 1 and s.ses_updated_at < date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{staleMinutes} minute)) or (s.ses_report_status = 3 and s.ses_report_retry < #{maxRetry})) order by s.ses_end_at asc limit 5
